title: Graham McDonnell: experience as a big serif roll call
note: After a dark intro, the page fades to frosted silver and lists clients in one centred column of large light serif names (Apple, Time Magazine, The New York Times, IPG MediaBrands, The Mill Group, Freelance), each with a tiny superscript year range. The names are set in a faint grey on the silver, so the list reads like an engraving. Nothing else on screen. Worth reusing: employers as the hero of the page, set big, instead of logos or a timeline.
